note: One hosted API generator, 12 L1 + 12 L7 items, M=10, 240 requests. Nothing here modifies a frozen artefact, a gate constant or a threshold.

deepseek-flash.peak_hours: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday-Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays
deepseek-flash.thinking_mode: supports non-thinking and thinking; thinking is the documented default, so the runner must confirm which mode served the request
deepseek-flash.notes: cheapest documented option; serving model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017

deepseek-v4-pro.notes: flagship tier; higher capability, higher price, still inside the cap at this size

gpt-6-luna.logprobs: must be confirmed on the model before the run
gpt-6-luna.notes: cheapest documented OpenAI tier on the current pricing page

gpt-6.1-sol.logprobs: must be confirmed on the model before the run
gpt-6.1-sol.notes: listed for comparison; its estimated maximum cost exceeds the 0.50 cap at this pilot size, which is what the cap is for

privacy.what_is_sent: the system prompt and one synthetic legal question per request, plus the model's own replies
what_is_not_sent: no client data, no case files, no personal data
no frozen run artefacts, no scores, no labels
no repository contents other than the prompt text
privacy.data_origin: synthetic items generated from the published IPC/BNS successor mapping; the slice is flagged verified=false
privacy.provider_retention: governed by the chosen provider's API terms; DeepSeek and OpenAI both retain request data for abuse monitoring under their standard terms unless a zero-retention arrangement is in place
privacy.residual_risk: the questions themselves are not confidential, but they would leave the machine; the legal caveat is that the dataset is unverified, so the answers are not legal advice and must not be published as such
